title: Meeting conflicts
description: Output of the conflict-detection step, saved as storage/meetings/<meeting_id>/conflicts.json. An empty list means the meeting was checked and nothing conflicted.

kind.description: speaker_disagreement: people in the meeting disagree with each other. speech_vs_slide: something said contradicts what a slide shows.

severity.description: How much it matters: high = affects dates, money, scope or a decision; low = minor detail.

status.description: resolved only if the meeting clearly settled it.

title.description: One line naming both sides, e.g. 'Budget: $120,000 on the slide, $95,000 approved'.

description.description: One or two sentences explaining the conflict.

positions.description: The sides of the conflict, at least two.

resolution.description: How it was settled, or null if it wasn't.

speaker.description: Name of the person holding this position, as used in the meeting. null when the position comes from a slide, or when the speaker isn't known.

statement.description: This side's position in one sentence.

segment_ids.description: Transcript segments that show this position: the 'id' values from transcript.json.

slide_numbers.description: Slides that show this position: 'slide_number' values from slides_text.json.
